This pathway implies that Dalotuzumab may exert its effects on ENPP6 via the intermediate of UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2B10. The evidence suggests a possible indirect interaction, where Dalotuzumab influences the activity of a downstream enzyme that ultimately affects ENPP6. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it is based on a single score of 0.5788, which indicates a moderate level of confidence in the relationship. The mechanism involves a chain of targets, but the exact nature of the interaction between Dalotuzumab and ENPP6 remains unclear, necessitating further investigation to confirm the direct involvement of Dalotuzumab in the regulation of ENPP6.
